title: Language Families and Linguistics
text: Human language is organized into families of languages that share a common ancestor. The Indo-European family, the world's most widely spoken, includes English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Russian, and hundreds of others. The Sino-Tibetan family includes Mandarin Chinese and Tibetan. The Afroasiatic family includes Arabic and Hebrew. Linguistics is the scientific study of language, encompassing phonetics (sounds), phonology (sound systems), morphology (word structure), syntax (sentence structure), semantics (meaning), and pragmatics (language in context). Noam Chomsky's theory of universal grammar proposed that humans have an innate language acquisition device, though this remains debated.
